english.title: Fail to make aerodrome available for use by Contracting States / Commonwealth aircraft on same terms as UK aircraft
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of an aerodrome in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), which was open to public use by aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, failed to cause the aerodrome and all of its air navigation facilities to be available for use by aircraft registered in other Contracting States or in any part of the Commonwealth on the same terms and conditions as for use by aircraft registered in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 216 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
